avis.titre: My skin was like, perpetually chapped
avis.texte: This is the holy grail. This is THE STUFF. I'm in my late 20's and I was diagnosed with "pre-rosacea" - a mild redness to my cheeks and jawline, but none of the other symptoms such as acne. My skin looked and felt chronically dry to the point of itching no matter what I used. My skin was like, perpetually chapped. I tried everything: dandruff shampoo (for the selenium), zinc/sulphur soap (anti-bacterial), sea buckthorn oil, primrose oil, hemp oil, maracuja oil (anti-inflammatory), and azelaic acid (finacea). Nothing worked and if anything they all just exacerbated the problem. Enter niacinamide aka B3 aka the miracle ingredient that not only has anti-aging properties but, as it turns out, the ability to "address skin discolorations". Yeeeeah, you can side-eye that description if you want, I too am tired of reading about how blahblah ingredient calms redness or is an anti-inflammatory (anti-inflammatory for me=run for the hills because you're about to get a big old dose of RED) But no, niacinamide has bigger plans than that. It is a 'cell communicating' ingredient that basically tells your well-meaning but crappier skin cells "hey, wake up and behave like you care a little". You know how when you first wake up your skin is clear and beautiful and ohmygod I-am-having-the-best-skin day ever, til you actually stand up and start moving around and then BAM it's like you ran hot water on your face except it never goes away? This product actually somehow maintains that morning skin f

In my early 20s (26 now) I figured out that my skin doesn't play well with most products and that it's actually not acne-prone pretty much at all if I use gentle products designed for sensitive skin (face wash, moisturizer, toner, etc) and don't over-dry it with harsh products; I can wear any makeup I want, pretty much, too, and my skin is fine as long as I wash it off well at night. Previously, I wrote a great review for this product, because parts of my face WERE looking softer and luminous (turns out this was Paula's Choice's AHA doing this, which I've been using for a couple of weeks now and LOVE and will never stop using). This review applies to each of these products individually, because they all work great on their own and together as a routine. I’ve been using these CeraVe skincare products consistently, and they’ve been really reliable for my skin. This is the combo I use for normal to oily skin, especially because I usually get oil buildup around my nose and forehead, along with pretty bad breakouts. Since starting this routine, my skin feels more balanced and easier to manage. The Acne Foaming Cream Cleanser leaves my skin feeling really soft, smooth, and genuinely clean without making it feel stripped or dry. It feels refreshing and does a great job removing oil and buildup while still being gentle. The Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Serum makes my skin feel soft, hydrated, and healthy. It absorbs quickly and doesn’t feel heavy or sticky — honestly, it barely feels like anything is on my skin, which I really like. The PM Facial Moisturizing Lotion keeps my skin moisturized and comfortable without feeling greasy. Just like the serum, it’s very lightweight and doesn’t feel like I’m wearing anything on my skin, but it still keeps my face feeling soft and hydrated. Overall, this routine makes my skin feel clean, soft, balanced, and hydrated without feeling heavy. If anyone else struggles with oily areas around the nose and forehead or frequent breakouts like I do, this is definitely the combo to go for. {This same review is on each of the items I use descriptions}

avis.titre: CeravVe PM,  Long Time User,  My Favorite
avis.texte: Long time user & satisfied customer of CeraVe PM. The difference between AM & PM lotion is AM contains sunscreen. Some reviewers say this does not contain special ingredients, I respectfully disagree. CeraVe PM contains niacinamide and ceramides. It’s versatile and works with my other skincare. This moisturizer lets me customize my skin care day by day. I prefer to add in a separate retinol a few nights a week and Vitamin C a few mornings so I do not want to buy moisturizer with retinol or Vitamin C. I apply this lotion morning & evening. For daytime I put on CeraVe first and then sunscreen on top. The pump dispenser has an open/lock setting which is great for travel and 3 oz. size TSA approved for bringing liquids thru security. I use about 5 or 6 bottles of these per year. CeraVe PM feels good on my skin and does not clog my pores. It’s gentle and I can use this around my eyes including eyelids without irritation. I mix this in my hand with vitamin C serum and apply to my face & neck. I live in hot humid Houston and I was a shiny oily mess until I found CeraVe PM. I feel like it balances out my skin. Great moisturizer that I will repurchase. 8-6-23

I've tried all kinds of products to get rid of acne/blackheads/scars and I guess never realized how important my night moisturizer was. This stuff is so light but it really is very moisturizing. My skin finally has everything it needs to repair and protect itself without being weighed down. My skin is so clear since I've been using this, so soft and I can tell after just 5 or 6 weeks that my uneven skin tone is evening out. I'm very happy with it. At night I use just a charcoal soap I got from a local farmers market, Burt's bees eye cream, and this moisturizer. I don't really wear makeup, sometimes I'll wear blush and mascara but my face is usually bare.

I’ve been using the CeraVe PM Facial Moisturizing Lotion as part of my nighttime routine and it has worked really well for my combination skin. The texture is lightweight, smooth, and absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy or heavy feeling. What I love most is how hydrating yet gentle it is. My skin feels soft, balanced, and calm by the morning. It layers nicely with my other skincare products and hasn’t caused any breakouts or irritation. The formula feels simple and reliable, which is exactly what I look for in a daily moisturizer. Overall, a great affordable staple for maintaining healthy, hydrated skin.
